48 × 48 inches; 300 points. Two Communication Antennas are at (0,-12) and (0,+12). One Tech-Coffin is at (0,0). Positions are X,Z in inches from board centre.

Official mission:
https://experience.corvusbelli.com/en/game-content/bf606d32-d933-4e1d-a6d9-5f92a9faef85

Each Antenna Activated by your side: 2 OP.
Each Antenna you physically Control: 1 OP.
Control the central Tech-Coffin: 3 OP.
Have an Active Lieutenant: 1 OP.

Activation and physical Control are separate. A Lieutenant must avoid Null, Isolated and Immobilized states to count as Active.

Deploy on opposite X edges. Each zone is 16 inches deep, placing the front lines at X=-8 and X=+8.

No deployment in Silhouette contact with an Antenna or the Tech-Coffin.

DZ +4 and DZ +8 are measuring aids. There is no added exclusion-zone overlay. No HVT Model, Secure HVT or Classified Deck is used.

A Specialist in Silhouette contact Activates with a Normal WIP Roll, spending a Short Skill. The enemy may Activate it later and take activation ownership.

Control requires at least one non-Null troop Model in Silhouette contact and no enemy qualifying Model in contact. Markers cannot Control.

Operational Learning: consecutive retries by the same troop, Skill and target receive +3 WIP on the second Order; +3 and +1SD from the third. Interruptions or success reset the sequence.

Use normal Infinity movement, cover and line-of-fire rules. Planting beds, water equipment and campus paving have no added Difficult Terrain rule. Use the solid geometry.

States: 1 roof on; 2 interior or upper floor exposed; 3 ground floor exposed on two-storey buildings. Exterior ladders remain in every state. Greenhouse roof glazing follows its parent state. The narrow metal roof spine is a maintenance walkway. Furnishings and partitions leave movement aisles.

The right-side drawer starts open. DZ, DZ +4, DZ +8, Booty, Metachemistry, Mission, Day, Night and Background Off are available.

Each player opens mission references independently. Grid and snapping start off.

Three Game Rounds; a turn beginning in Retreat! ends the game at that turn end.

Clear Table removes the complete map, including changed building states and glazing, and restores the prior background and lighting.
